doc: Loops over a0->arr[1..6] (7-element array of Elem* hanging off offset 0x68), decaying each element's sub-object HP/timer-like s16 field at offset+2: if positive, subtracts 0x100 (via the unsigned view of the same field); otherwise clamps to 0. After the loop, checks a0->arr[6]'s same field; if it has hit exactly zero, installs func_80050494 as a0's function-pointer field (offset 0). Finally tail-calls func_80050308(a0).
calls: func_80050494(void *a0) -- matched, defined in src/code.c, thin wrapper forwarding to func_80050308
func_80050308(void *a0) -- extern, declared in src/code.c (INCLUDE_ASM), not yet matched
